description: This file implements a performance profiling utility in Go, including profiling functions, memory usage tracking, and a Profiler class with methods for profiling code execution and capturing metrics.

classes.name: Profile
classes.description: Represents performance metrics for an operation, including duration, memory usage, and optional line/byte counts.

classes.name: Profiler
classes.description: Provides methods for profiling functions, capturing performance metrics, and managing profiling state.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a human-readable string representation of a Profile instance.

methods.name: safeMemoryDelta
methods.description: Calculates the difference in memory usage before and after an operation, handling overflow cases.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Creates a new Profiler instance with specified logger and enabled state.

methods.name: ProfileFunc
methods.description: Profiles a function execution, capturing duration and memory usage.

methods.name: ProfileFuncWithMetrics
methods.description: Profiles a function execution, capturing duration, memory, lines, and bytes.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts timing an operation and returns a function to complete profiling.

methods.name: IsProfilingEnabled
methods.description: Checks environment variable to determine if profiling is enabled.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the global profiler with specified logger and enabled state.

methods.name: InitFromEnv
methods.description: Initializes the global profiler based on environment variables.
